Type: compact media cabinet
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storage; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: grey wood-grain veneer, herringbone door pattern, black metal legs
Colors: warm grey, black
Shape: low rectangular case, herringbone drop door on one side, two open shelves on the other, slim black metal legs with side braces, compact and light
Feel: modern, calm, textured
Goes with: grey or white walls, black metal, light woods; modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Media Cabinet, 47"W, Gray
product.description: The shelving and pullout drawer in this sleek, modern media cabinet offer plenty of storage space for electronic and multimedia components. The strong lines and metal legs produce a contemporary flair, while the patterned panels add that touch of elegance every home needs. 47"W x 16"D x 16"H Engineered wood with metal legs This modern media console makes a wonderful accent piece in any home. The shelving and 1 pull drawer make this media cabinet great for storage. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe clean with a dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
